notes.subject: מתרפס
notes.rationale: רפס — daɲɛ in Tanaki kɔnɔ, o yɔrɔ de bɛɛ; kɔrɔ ye ka bin ka fiɲɛ-sigi ye

notes.subject: חית קנה
notes.rationale: 'bagan min bɛ bin na' — a bɛ se ka kɛ kɛlɛ-mɔgɔba ye (misiri, crocodile) walima jamana ye min bɛ kɔgɔji dakan da (Misira); KJV fɔ 'spear-bagatɔw'

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ Yawe wele ka a kan da jamana kɛlɛbagaw kan

notes.subject: עמים ... עמים
notes.rationale: 'siyaw' ni 'jama' — Heburukan daɲɛ kelen de don, daɲɛ fila minnu filen don kuma in kɔnɔ

translation: Ka i ka kan da ⟨bagan⟩ kan min bɛ bin na, misi cuburulew ka jama la, siyaw ka misidenw ye, u bɛ warigwɛ kunw buguri-kɛ; ka jama minnu bɛ kɛlɛ fɛ, u bɔ ɲɔgɔn na.

tokens.gloss: ka i ka kan da … kan
